plate.cravingSub: Add your foods. Chef Mealan sets the amounts.
plate.cravingHint: Finds dishes in your recipes, Coach's, the members' and Chef Mealan's, and your foods. Add PD 7+ to keep only dishes at PD 7 or more.
plate.fromMyRecipes: From My recipes. Change what you like, then Fit to my target or Keep it as it is.
plate.amountChef: Chef Mealan can change this amount.
plate.underPortion: {grams} g is under a portion of {food}, {min} to {max} g.
plate.swipe: Swipe a food left to swap it, right to remove it.
plate.addOneFirst: Add one food first. Chef Mealan builds the {meal} around it.
plate.oldHelp: Ate it saves it to {day}, to the meal it was set for, at the time it was started. Save for later keeps it to finish another time, and the Plate is free. Keep working on it opens it as it is, and this plate is not asked about again. Clear it empties the plate.
plate.oldHelpPhoto: Ate it saves it to {day}, to the meal it was set for, at the photo's time. Save for later keeps it to finish another time, and the Plate is free. Keep working on it opens it as it is, and this plate is not asked about again. Clear it empties the plate.
plate.cookAskHelp: Whichever you pick, {dish} then starts on its own plate. Cancel goes back to the recipe.
plate.saveMineHelp: Save my plate for later keeps it to finish another time; it waits at the top of the Plate. Clear my plate empties it. Cancel goes back to the recipe.
plate.addOrNewHelp: Add to my plate: the new foods join yours, and the plate keeps its name. Start a new plate: only the new foods.
plate.addOrNewHelpPhoto: Add to my plate: the new foods join yours, marked ~, and the plate keeps its name. Start a new plate: only the new foods.
today.setYourTrainingWeekAnd: Set your Training week, and Chef Mealan won't need to ask ›
today.nothingPlannedOrEatenYet: Nothing planned or eaten yet today
today.pickOneOfYourMeals: Pick one of your meals, or make one on the Plate.
today.setTheDaySMeals: Set the day's meals, and they wait here
today.yourAnswerClosesTheCook: Your answer closes the cook: the strip goes, the card keeps it all.
today.seeTheDayAgainstIts: See the day against its plan
today.justForYouItStays: Just for you: it stays on this card and with the recipe's photos. Members never see it unless you pick it when sharing.
today.whyOneTapIsEnough: Why? One tap is enough; a line is extra.
today.changedForTodayOnlyYour: Changed for today only. Your Training week stays the same.
today.ifTodayGoesDifferentlyTap: If today goes differently, tap the pencil. The numbers follow, the Training week stays.
today.noKindOfDayWas: No kind of day was set
today.opensThePageInExplorer: Opens the page in Explorer, with your case.
today.left: About {kcal} kcal and {protein} g protein left for today.

today.atKcal.text: You are at your day's kcal. A light {meal} keeps you there.

dayedit.lightMeansYouCouldChat: Light means you could chat while doing it. Hard means you couldn't.
dayedit.optionalPlanShowsAClock: Optional. Plan shows a clock time only when you set one.
dayedit.nothingPlannedAWalkOr: Nothing planned. A walk or yoga is an activity; pick it instead.
dayedit.noTrainingYourWorkAnd: No training. Your work and your steps still count.
measured.logEveryMealAndWeigh: Log every meal, and weigh in most mornings.
measured.theAverageOfYourFull: The average of your full days: every planned meal eaten, swapped or skipped on purpose, and anything extra logged. Days with a meal missing don't count.
measured.whatYouAtePlusKcal: What you ate, plus 7,700 kcal for each kg the line went down, or minus for each kg it went up, spread over the 14 days.
measured.itGoesOnWithThe: It goes on with the last 14 days until it is ready.
measured.yourNumbersStayAsThey: Your numbers stay as they are until you choose. This card keeps updating from your last 14 days.
plan.thisDateOnlyYourTraining: This date only. Your Training week stays the same.
plan.nothingWasLoggedOnThis: Nothing was logged on this day.

plan.aDayBeforeTodayIs.text: A day before today is what you ate: it counts at its meal's time. Nothing to make, no rating asked.

plan.tapAFoodOnceWhen: Tap a food once when it is in the basket, twice for not this time.
plan.thePlanChangedSinceThis: The plan changed since this list was made
plan.createANewMealOn: Create a new meal on the Plate
plan.changeTheTrainingForThis: Change the training for this date
plan.addASnackOrMake: Add a snack, or make the portions bigger.
plan.makeThePortionsSmallerOr: Make the portions smaller, or swap a meal.
plan.thisDayOnlyNoRecipe: This day only. No recipe stands behind it.
plan.tapAMealToPut: Tap a meal to put it in this slot.
calendar.aSlotWithAMeal: A slot with a meal on Plan goes in; an open slot stays out. Plan a meal, and it shows within seconds.
calendar.chefMealanWritesYourPlan: Chef Mealan writes your plan into a calendar of its own, called Chef Mealan, in your Google Calendar. It never reads or changes your other events.
calendar.eachKindIsOnOr: Each kind is on or off. Change it any time.
calendar.theNameTheTimeAnd: The name, the time, and a link that opens that day on Plan. Never kcal, protein, your goal or anything about your health. Calendars get shared with family and colleagues, so the numbers stay in the app.
calendar.googleAsksYouOnceFor: Google asks you once for one right: to create the Chef Mealan calendar and manage the events in it. Nothing else. You can take it back in your Google account at any time.
calendar.chefMealanStopsWritingWhat: Chef Mealan stops writing. What about the calendar?
calendar.deletingYourAccountAlsoRemoves: Deleting your account also removes the Chef Mealan calendar.
calendar.fromYourCalendarToThe: From your calendar to the app
calendar.busyAndFreeTimesOnly: Busy and free times only. Never the titles, the people or the places of your events.
calendar.withItPlanSuggestsA: With it, Plan suggests: a meal moved out of a meeting, a quick dinner after a late evening, a meal to carry on a full day, and asks when training sits in a busy block. It suggests; your times change only when you tap.
calendar.aChefMealanMealYou: A Chef Mealan meal you move in Google Calendar, on the same day, takes that time here too.
calendar.breakfastLunchDinnerAtYour: Breakfast, lunch, dinner at your times
calendar.cookDinnerMinutesBeforeWhen: Cook dinner, 30 minutes before, when the planned meal has steps
calendar.yourTrainingDaysAtTheir: Your training days, at their time
calendar.chefMealanStoppedWritingAnd: Chef Mealan stopped writing, and the calendar is removed from Google.
calendar.chefMealanStoppedWritingThe: Chef Mealan stopped writing. The calendar stays in Google as it is.
calendar.bringingGoogleCalendarUpTo: Bringing Google Calendar up to date…
plan.heldInSlot: {dish} is in this slot. Tap another meal to swap it.
